newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Vencemos started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Vencemos started as buy.

text.p: -- Paribas Capital Markets started coverage of Venezuelan cement maker Vencemos with a buy rating

-- Analyst Peregrine Winfield said the company was trading at a 50 percent 1997 price/cash flow discount to its Latin American peers and had a fair value price target of $4.15, double the current price.
-- The company's I and II share series closed Thursday up 20.00 bolivars to 1320.00 ($2.84) and up 35.00 bolivars at 1135.00 ($2.45) respectively.
-- Winfield said economic recovery in 1997 will boost Venezuelan cement demand, with domestic sales seen rising six percent after a five percent fall in 1996.
-- With dividends already high at a 48 percent payout, rising free cashflow generation makes an acquisition outside Venezuela likely, Winfield said.
-- Vencemos is an affiliate of Mexican cement company Cemex
